reviews.review_text: I ordered 3 of these puck lights to place in closets that needed a bit more light. They came with batteries, but 1 had dead batteries. I didn't expect the batteries to be included, so that did not matter. The lights are a good size diameter, but I thought they would be a little brighter.

reviews.title: GV Wireless LED Tap Light
reviews.review_text: The price is very reasonable, but don't buy the light thinking it will operate like a floodlight. Be reasonable with expectations. It is more or less supplemental light where more is needed. I put two in each closet. Originally planned to put a couple underneath my upper cabinets to better light certain areas of countertop but decided it wouldn't provide the needed brightness for kitchen work. It would be great to put on decorated shelves that need a little light or so many other places. Good product for adding supplemental or accent lighting.
Very Useful when lights go off can used during bad weather

one was broken and would not work. second works fine. just goes through batteries very quickly

reviews.title: Ok… battery cover comes right off though
reviews.review_text: I had to buy 4. They work well. Great under the cabinet and in the closets. However! That battery cover comes right off. I had to find a little screw to put in the notch- to be able to install it in conjunction with the Velcro that comes on it. I even tried taping the battery cover on and it somehow still slipped off without the screw. It's nothing that will cause me to return them. They work well and give off a nice amount of light. If they were more than $5 I probably would have not bothered.

reviews.title: Lights but no power
reviews.review_text: Bought 2 of these mostly to have in case of power outage. The lights themselves are great. However, I wanted to buy batteries to go with them, but looked high an low and didn't find them. I checked the checkout counters where most stores have some.. none.. the cashier told me there was 1 counter with them "locked up".. come on.. that's crazy.

reviews.title: Battery cover isn't sturdy enough for under cabinets
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] I decided to put this light under the counter so it's a lot easier to make coffee in the early morning. It worked great for lighting until several times I came home to find the light had come unattached and fell to the floor with batteries scattered everywhere. I recommend using something besides the Velcro provided and then not really sure that will work because the cover seems to be the issue and it unlatches. Installation was simple and it was bright so that is a plus. But, definitely have to figure out the cover issue.
